scope: 29 editorial READY rows only, without 21 HOLD rows

records.proposed_gloss_en: the belief that people of some racial groups are superior to others, or unfair treatment based on race
records.specific_reason: 将种族优越论信念与基于种族的不平等待遇纳入定义，基本覆盖对应中文；注意不把单纯群体差别描述视为种族主义。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to state or confirm officially that something meets a standard or is true
records.specific_reason: 官方证明事实或符合标准的及物动词义准确，与认证/证明对应。

records.proposed_gloss_en: using radio signals instead of wires to send information
records.specific_reason: 英文只定义无线传输手段；中文同时含‘无线通信’名词义，需词性/POS核验或限定形容词用法。

records.proposed_gloss_en: an object kept or bought to remind someone of a place or event
records.specific_reason: 因地点或活动留下纪念的物件定义准确。

records.proposed_gloss_en: a thin thread-like strand that forms part of cloth, plants, or other materials
records.specific_reason: 细长丝状物可指纺织、植物等材料纤维，与现有中文相符。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to close and open one eye quickly, often to communicate silently
records.specific_reason: 单眼短促闭合以表达信号，正确区分一般双眼眨动。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to express sadness or regret about something
records.specific_reason: 表达悲痛或遗憾对应哀叹，可作动词；需维持动词词性。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to make a broad statement or rule based on particular examples
records.specific_reason: 由具体例子提炼一般规则的义正确；中文‘推广’若指推广营销则不在本义，应限定泛化推广。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to cause someone severe physical or emotional suffering
records.specific_reason: 使他人遭受严重身心痛苦，对应折磨的动词义。

records.proposed_gloss_en: bags and cases taken by someone on a journey
records.specific_reason: 旅途携带包箱的集合名词义准确，可不覆盖抽象情感包袱。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to refuse to buy from, use, or deal with someone as a form of protest
records.specific_reason: 为抗议而拒买/拒用/拒往来，是抵制行为核心。

records.proposed_gloss_en: a sharp curved nail on the foot of an animal or bird
records.specific_reason: 动物脚上弯曲尖爪义准确，非抓挠的动词义。

records.proposed_gloss_en: a category of art, music, literature, or film with a particular style
records.specific_reason: 按风格区分艺术文学影视类型，对应体裁/类型。

records.proposed_gloss_en: an armed group of civilians organized for military activity, not usually the regular army
records.specific_reason: 非正规军的武装民间团体定义适合民兵组织义，但不同法域militia可纳入官方组织，不应过度限定非法武装。

records.proposed_gloss_en: separately, one person or thing at a time
records.specific_reason: 分别逐个处理人或事物，副词含义准确。

records.proposed_gloss_en: a small case carried in a pocket or bag for money and cards
records.specific_reason: 装钱和卡的随身小包，与钱包一致。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to make a statement or situation easier to understand by explaining it
records.specific_reason: 通过解释使陈述/情况清楚，与澄清阐明一致。

records.proposed_gloss_en: a starting level or measurement used to compare later results
records.specific_reason: 后续结果比较的初始测量或水平，基线与基准两义相容。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to close and open your eyes quickly
records.specific_reason: 英文只覆盖双眼快速闭合，中文‘闪烁’（灯光、屏幕）没有覆盖；需增加发光物闪烁义或拆义。

records.proposed_gloss_en: land covered with grass where animals feed
records.specific_reason: 覆盖牲畜放牧进食的草地，中文牧场若指整套牧业经营场所略宽，但常用草场义可成立。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to choose not to use or demand a right, fee, or requirement
records.specific_reason: 主动放弃行使权利、费用要求或规则条件义准确；尤其waive a fee是免除收取而非付费者自行放弃。

records.proposed_gloss_en: extremely good or impressive
records.specific_reason: 极好或令人印象深刻，涵盖常见积极评价；‘令人敬畏的’更正式语域需补注但不阻断。

records.proposed_gloss_en: able to make decisions quickly and confidently, or producing a clear result
records.specific_reason: 英语合并‘人做决定果断’与‘因素/结果具有决定性’两义，中文两项均在但跨搭配语法角色，若KU按单Sense训练需区分或加语境标注。

records.proposed_gloss_en: happening or appearing at regular intervals
records.specific_reason: 以规律间隔出现，周期性与定期均准确。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to wash something quickly with clean water to remove soap or dirt
records.specific_reason: 以清水快速冲洗去除污物/肥皂，与冲洗漂洗吻合；不限定必须快速完成。

records.proposed_gloss_en: harmful or unfavorable
records.specific_reason: 不利或造成损害的形容词，通常修饰conditions/effects，中文准确。

records.proposed_gloss_en: a device that detects or measures changes such as light, heat, or movement
records.specific_reason: 感测热光运动等物理变化的装置即传感器。

records.proposed_gloss_en: a soft thick mixture that can be spread on a surface
records.specific_reason: 可涂抹浓稠混合物即糊状物，正确限制为名词非粘贴动词。

records.proposed_gloss_en: to move quietly and secretly so that no one notices
records.specific_reason: 悄悄秘密移动避免被发现，符合偷偷走/潜行。
